title: Compact command board
prompt: Auralis desktop meeting dashboard with a one-line navigation, compact contextual counts, a two-thirds ruled meeting library, and a right column containing a charcoal audio readiness module and restrained processing legend. Cool white canvas, indigo controls, cyan signal traces, Geist-like typography, 8px radii, and no unsupported product claims.
approval: Delegated implementation choice based on the user-pinned Auralis brief and current repository capabilities. Selected for strongest task clarity and easiest removal of mock-only data.
